request.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:SHORECRAFT

layers.text: Change only the colours of the boot: its orange-brown leather becomes dark brown-grey hide, colour #594f4d with shade #2d2b2b, not orange and not red-brown; the fur cuff round its top and its toe cap become cream white fur, colour #f9e8c6 with shade #aa856e. Do not redraw anything else: keep the boot's shape, the bright blue ice blade under it with its white shine, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
